method.description: Lexical/rendering divergence indicator; not a doctrinal truth score or majority vote.
method.normalization: case, punctuation, footnote markers, and common KJV archaisms normalized

sources.bsb: Berean Standard Bible (Public Domain / CC0). bereanbible.com.
sources.asv: American Standard Version (1901; Public Domain). ebible.org/asv/.
sources.brenton: Brenton's translation of the Septuagint (1844/1851; Public Domain). ebible.org/eng-Brenton/.
sources.kjv: King James Version, ebible.org 2006 transcription (Public Domain in US).

pob.text: The vision of Obadiah[a]. Thus says the Lord GOD concerning Edom: We have heard a report from Yahweh, and a messenger has been sent among the nations: “Rise up[c][b], and let us rise against her for battle.”

spob.text:
Obadiah’s vision.

This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom:

“We have heard a report from Yahweh, and a messenger has been sent among the nations: ‘Rise up! Let us rise against her[a] for battle.’”[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: This is the vision of Obadiah: This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom— We have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent among the nations to say, “Rise up, and let us go to battle against her!”—
public_domain_references.web: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.
public_domain_references.asv: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning Edom: We have heard tidings from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
public_domain_references.kjv: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
public_domain_references.brenton: The vision of Obdias. Thus saith the Lord God to Idumea; I have heard a report from the Lord, and he has sent forth a message to the nations.

pob.text: Look[a], I have made you small among the nations[b]; you are greatly despised.

spob.text: Pay attention! I have made you small and unimportant among the nations. You are deeply despised.

public_domain_references.bsb: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, I have made thee small among the nations: thou art greatly despised.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
public_domain_references.brenton: Arise ye, and let us rise up against her to war.

pob.text: The pride of your heart has deceived you[a], you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose dwelling is on high, who say in your heart[c][b], “Who will bring me down to the ground?”

spob.text: The pride in your heart has deceived you. You live high up in rocky crevices[a], and you tell yourself, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”

public_domain_references.bsb: The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
public_domain_references.web: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
public_domain_references.asv: The pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation [is] high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, I have made thee small among the Gentiles: thou art greatly dishonoured. The pride of thine heart has elated thee, dwelling [as thou dost] in the holes of the rocks, [as one that] exalts his habitation, saying in his heart, Who will bring me down to the ground?

pob.text: Though you soar high like the eagle[a], and though you set your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, declares Yahweh.

spob.text: Even if you soar high like an eagle and place your nest among the stars, I will bring you down from there, declares Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: Though thou mount on high as the eagle, and though thy nest be set among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Though thou exalt [thyself] as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: If thou shouldest mount up as the eagle, and if thou shouldest make thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.

pob.text: If thieves came to you[a], if robbers by night—how you have been destroyed!—would they not steal only enough for themselves? If grape gatherers came to you[b], would they not leave gleanings?

spob.text: If thieves came to you, or robbers came at night—yet look how you have been ruined![a]—wouldn’t they steal only enough for themselves? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave a few grapes behind?

public_domain_references.bsb: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night— oh, how you will be ruined— would they not steal only what they wanted? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings?
public_domain_references.web: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?
public_domain_references.asv: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night (how art thou cut off!), would they not steal [only] till they had enough? if grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes?
public_domain_references.kjv: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave [some] grapes?
public_domain_references.brenton: If thieves came in to thee, or robbers by night, where wouldest thou have been cast away? would they not have stolen [just] enough for themselves? and if grape-gatherers went in to thee, would they not leave a gleaning?

pob.text: How Esau has been searched out! His hidden treasures have been sought out![a][b]

spob.text: How thoroughly Esau has been searched! His hidden treasures have been uncovered![a]

public_domain_references.bsb: But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!
public_domain_references.web: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
public_domain_references.asv: How are [the things of] Esau searched! how are his hidden treasures sought out!
public_domain_references.kjv: How are [the things] of Esau searched out! [how] are his hidden things sought up!
public_domain_references.brenton: How has Esau been searched out, and [how] have his hidden things been detected?

pob.text: All the men of your covenant have sent you to the border[a]; the men at peace with you have deceived you and prevailed against you[c][b]. Those who eat your bread have set a trap under you—there is no understanding in him.

spob.text: All your covenant partners have sent you to the border.[a] Those who were at peace with you have deceived and overcome you. Those who eat your bread have set a trap beneath you.[b] There is no understanding in him.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: All the men allied with you will drive you to the border; the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you. Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you without your awareness of it.
public_domain_references.web: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”
public_domain_references.asv: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee on thy way, even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; [they that eat] thy bread lay a snare under thee: there is no understanding in him.
public_domain_references.kjv: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee [even] to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, [and] prevailed against thee; [they that eat] thy bread have laid a wound under thee: [there is] none understanding in him.
public_domain_references.brenton: They sent thee to thy coasts: all the men of thy covenant have withstood thee; thine allies have prevailed against thee, they have set snares under thee: they have no understanding.

pob.text: Will I not[a], on that day, declares Yahweh, destroy the wise men from Edom, and understanding from the mountain of Esau?

spob.text: Yahweh declares, “On that day, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and take away understanding from the mountain of Esau?”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
public_domain_references.web: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
public_domain_references.asv: Shall I not in that day, saith Jehovah, destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
public_domain_references.kjv: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, even destroy the wise [men] out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
public_domain_references.brenton: In that day, saith the Lord, I will destroy the wise men out of Idumea, and understanding out of the mount of Esau.

pob.text: And your mighty men[a], Teman, will be shattered[c][b], so that every man from the mountain of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

spob.text: Teman, your warriors will be shattered.[a] This will happen so that every man from the mountain of Esau may be cut off through slaughter.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
public_domain_references.web: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
public_domain_references.asv: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thy mighty [men], O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thy warriors from Thæman shall be dismayed, to the end that man may be cut off from the mount of Esau.

pob.text: Because of the violence done to your brother Jacob[a], shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

spob.text: Because you acted violently against your brother Jacob,[a] shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

public_domain_references.bsb: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and cut off forever.
public_domain_references.web: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
public_domain_references.asv: For the violence done to thy brother Jacob, shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ For [thy] violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
public_domain_references.brenton: Because of the slaughter and the sin [committed against] thy brother Jacob, shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

pob.text: On the day when you stood aloof[a], on the day strangers carried off his wealth, and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem[c][b], you too were like one of them.

spob.text: On the day strangers carried away Jerusalem’s wealth,[a] and foreigners entered the city’s gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you stood aside. You too were like one of them.

public_domain_references.bsb: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were just like one of them.
public_domain_references.web: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
public_domain_references.asv: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
public_domain_references.kjv: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou [wast] as one of them.
public_domain_references.brenton: From the day that thou stoodest in opposition [to him], in the days when foreigners were taking captive his forces, and strangers entered into his gates, and cast lots on Jerusalem, thou also wast as one of them.

pob.text: Do not look on your brother in the day of his misfortune[a], and do not rejoice over the sons of Judah in the day of their destruction[c][b]; and do not make your mouth great in the day of distress.

spob.text: Do not gloat over your brother when misfortune comes upon him.[a] Do not rejoice over the sons of Judah when destruction comes upon them. Do not open your mouth in arrogant boasting in a time of distress.

public_domain_references.bsb: But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast proudly in the day of their distress.
public_domain_references.web: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
public_domain_references.asv: But look not thou on the day of thy brother in the day of his disaster, and rejoice not over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither speak proudly in the day of distress.
public_domain_references.kjv: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day of strangers; nor shouldest thou have rejoiced against the children of Juda in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have boasted in the day of [their] affliction.

pob.text: Do not enter the gate of my people in the day of their disaster[a]; do not look on his calamity, even you, in the day of his disaster[b]; and do not lay hands on his wealth in the day of his disaster.

spob.text: Do not go through the gate into my people’s city on the day disaster strikes them.[a] You too must not gloat over his calamity on the day disaster strikes him. Do not seize his wealth[b] on the day disaster strikes him.

public_domain_references.bsb: You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over their affliction in the day of their disaster, nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster.
public_domain_references.web: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.
public_domain_references.asv: Enter not into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, look not thou on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither lay ye [hands] on their substance in the day of their calamity.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid [hands] on their substance in the day of their calamity;
public_domain_references.brenton: Neither shouldest thou have gone into the gates of the people in the day of their troubles; nor yet shouldest thou have looked upon their gathering in the day of their destruction, nor shouldest thou have attacked their host in the day of their perishing.

pob.text: Do not stand at the crossroads to cut off his fugitives[c][b][a], and do not hand over his survivors in the day of distress.

spob.text: Do not take your stand at the crossroads[a] to destroy those of his people who are fleeing. Do not hand over his survivors in their time of distress.

public_domain_references.bsb: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.
public_domain_references.web: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.
public_domain_references.asv: And stand thou not in the crossway, to cut off those of his that escape; and deliver not up those of his that remain in the day of distress.
public_domain_references.kjv: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
public_domain_references.brenton: Neither shouldest thou have stood at the opening of their passages, to destroy utterly those of them that were escaping; neither shouldest thou have shut up his fugitives in the day of affliction.

pob.text: For the day of Yahweh is near upon all the nations[a]. As you have done, it will be done to you[b]; your recompense will return on your own head.

spob.text: For the day of Yahweh is near, when judgment will come upon all the nations.[a] What you have done will be done to you. The repayment you deserve will come back on your own head.

public_domain_references.bsb: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
public_domain_references.web: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
public_domain_references.asv: For the day of Jehovah is near upon all the nations: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; thy dealing shall return upon thine own head.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the day of the LORD [is] near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
public_domain_references.brenton: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the Gentiles: as thou hast done, so shall it be [done] to thee: thy recompense shall be returned on thine [own] head.

pob.text: For just as you drank on my holy mountain[a], all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and swallow[b], and they will be as though they had never been.

spob.text: For you drank on my holy mountain. Just as you did, all the nations will keep drinking.[a] They will drink and swallow it all, and they will be as though they had never existed.

public_domain_references.bsb: For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.
public_domain_references.web: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
public_domain_references.asv: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the nations drink continually; yea, they shall drink, and swallow down, and shall be as though they had not been.
public_domain_references.kjv: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, [so] shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
public_domain_references.brenton: For as thou hast drunk upon my holy mountain, [so] shall all the nations drink wine; they shall drink, and go down, and be as if they were not.

pob.text: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance[a], and it will be holy[c][b], and the house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

spob.text: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance,[a] and the mountain will be holy. The people of Jacob will take possession of what belongs to them.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.
public_domain_references.web: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
public_domain_references.asv: But in mount Zion there shall be those that escape, and it shall be holy; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
public_domain_references.brenton: But on mount Sion there shall be deliverance, and there shall be a sanctuary; and the house of Jacob shall take for an inheritance those that took them for an inheritance.

pob.text: The house of Jacob will be a fire[a], and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will burn them and consume them, and there will be no survivor for the house of Esau[b], for Yahweh has spoken.

spob.text: Jacob’s people will be a fire, and Joseph’s people will be a flame. Esau’s people will be like dry stalks left after harvest. Together, Jacob’s and Joseph’s people will burn through them and consume them. No one among Esau’s people will survive, because Yahweh has spoken.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble— Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it. Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau.” For the LORD has spoken.
public_domain_references.web: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.
public_domain_references.asv: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall burn among them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining to the house of Esau; for Jehovah hath spoken it.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be [any] remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken [it].
public_domain_references.brenton: And the house of Jacob shall be fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau [shall be] for stubble; and [Israel] shall flame forth against them, and shall devour them, and there shall not be a corn-field [left] to the house of Esau; because the Lord has spoken.

pob.text: Those of the Negev will possess the hill country of Esau[a], and those of the Shephelah the land of the Philistines; they will also possess the territory of Ephraim and the territory of Samaria[b], and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

spob.text: People from the Negev will possess Esau’s hill country. People from the Shephelah lowlands will possess the land of the Philistines. They will also possess the territories of Ephraim and Samaria, and the people of Benjamin will possess Gilead.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau; those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
public_domain_references.web: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
public_domain_references.asv: And they of the South shall possess the mount of Esau, and they of the lowland the Philistines; and they shall possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria; and Benjamin [shall possess] Gilead.
public_domain_references.kjv: And [they of] the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and [they of] the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin [shall possess] Gilead.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they [that dwell] in the south shall inherit the mount of Esau, and they in the plain the Philistines: and they shall inherit the mount of Ephraim, and the plain of Samaria, and Benjamin, and the land of Galaad.

pob.text: And the exiles of this host of the sons of Israel, who are among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.

spob.text: The Israelite exiles from this group, living among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and the exiles from Jerusalem living in Sepharad will take possession of the cities of the Negev.

public_domain_references.bsb: And the exiles of this host of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negev.
public_domain_references.web: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.
public_domain_references.asv: And the captives of this host of the children of Israel, that are [among] the Canaanites, [shall possess] even unto Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, that are in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the South.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel [shall possess] that of the Canaanites, [even] unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which [is] in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
public_domain_references.brenton: And this [shall be] the domain of the captivity of the children of Israel, the land of the Chananites as far as Sarepta; and the captives of Jerusalem [shall inherit] as far as Ephratha; they shall inherit the cities of the south.

pob.text: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to judge the hill country of Esau[c][b][a], and the kingdom will belong to Yahweh.

spob.text: Deliverers[a] will climb Mount Zion to judge Esau’s hill country.[b] The kingdom will belong to the LORD.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.
public_domain_references.asv: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah’s.
public_domain_references.kjv: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD’s.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they that escape shall come up from mount Sion, to take vengeance on the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord's.
